messages:
marie.ops: RCA is up: https://internal.redwood/rca/2955551234. Summary: misrouted cache invalidations during a config roll caused stale KV reads and elevated error rates for ~20 minutes. Root cause: a deployment that skipped the cache-namespace migration step. Impact: increased 5xx for some API traffic and delayed model updates. Action table at the bottom 1; owners please ack by EOD.

pager-bot: Timeline: 07:18 deploy -> 07:23 error spike -> 07:30 partial rollback -> 07:38 migration applied -> 07:42 service stabilized. Traces and sample requests attached in the RCA.

own.eng: I'll take action "enforce migration hook". Plan: make the migration step a hard pre-deploy check in the CI pipeline and add a test that validates cache namespace version. ETA: Thu 2024-04-11.

rachel.prod: I'll draft the one-paragraph customer note for support teams. Will keep it non-technical and include mitigation + follow-up timeline. Posting draft here for review tomorrow morning.

tomo.sre: I'll own "post-deploy verification + watch". Steps: run synthetic reads against updated namespaces, add a short window alert if hit-rate deviates >5% after deploy. Proposed checkpoint: Mon 2024-04-15 09:00 PT. Confirm if that works.

marie.ops: Office hours to walk through the RCA and assign any unclaimed items: Fri 2024-04-12 10:30 PT (virtual link on calendar). Drop questions here beforehand.

own.eng: ✅ will open PR and link it here when ready.

rachel.prod: ✅ will post draft by tomorrow AM.

tomo.sre: ✅ checkpoint confirmed.

marie.ops: Two quick asks: 1) owners, react with :white_check_mark: when you accept; 2) please paste PR links and test evidence back in this thread so I can close actions after the one-week watch period. If anything urgent, escalate in #eng-oncall.
